title: LLMs Don't Pay for the Jump
abstract: arXiv:2608.14397v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Zahavy [2026] argues that Large Language Models, despite their capabilities in induction and deduction, cannot perform the abductive "Jump" that produced Einstein's equivalence principle, and attributes this limitation to the absence of embodied simulation. Zheng-Xin [2026] and Farmer [2026] question whether embodiment is necessary for abduction, pointing to alternative routes to General Relativity and forms of abduction that require no sensorimotor grounding. Max Planck resolved the blackbody radiation problem in 1900. Planck's move to E = h{\nu} required no embodied simulation. It was motivated by a mathematical consequence of classical theory, an infinite predicted energy for a finite measured quantity, that could not be physically accepted. We show that neither induction nor deduction could have produced the postulate and argue that its adoption required a coupling between epistemic error and physical cost. We formalize this distinct

translated_title: 大语言模型不为“跳跃”买单
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14397v1 公告类型：新 摘要：Zahavy [2026] 认为，尽管大语言模型在归纳和演绎方面表现出色，但它们无法进行产生爱因斯坦等效原理的溯因性“跳跃”，并将此限制归因于缺乏具身模拟。Zheng-Xin [2026] 和 Farmer [2026] 质疑具身性是否对溯因推理是必要的，指出通往广义相对论的替代路径以及无需感觉运动基础的溯因形式。马克斯·普朗克在1900年解决了黑体辐射问题。普朗克转向 E = hν 不需要具身模拟。它是由经典理论的一个数学后果所驱动的——对有限测量量的无限预测能量——这在物理上无法接受。我们表明，归纳和演绎都无法产生该假设，并论证其采纳需要认识论错误与物理代价之间的耦合。我们将这种区别形式化。
tldr: 本文提出大语言模型无法进行溯因“跳跃”，并论证普朗克假设的采纳依赖于认识论错误与物理代价的耦合，这区别于归纳和演绎。
en_tdlr: This paper argues that large language models cannot perform abductive "jumps" and demonstrates that Planck's postulate adoption required a coupling between epistemic error and physical cost, distinct from induction and deduction.
